visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An indoor traditional ancestral altar scene with dark wood paneling. Two white vases of colorful flowers flank a central wooden tablet with golden inscriptions. Red candles are lit. Plates of oranges and red apples are placed on the altar. (2) A middle-aged man with a white wig and long white beard, wearing a blue suit, fades into the frame in front of the altar. He touches his beard with his hand, looking bored and weary. Yellow captions appear in the center. (3) A sudden graphic shift reveals a table full of various steaming Chinese dishes, including a whole roast pig and diverse soups, appearing in front of the bearded character. He looks pleasantly surprised, mouth open, gesturing toward the food. (4) A man in a white chef uniform with black trim enters the frame, looking at the camera with an exaggerated expression of surprise. He holds a large purple box featuring photos of various dishes and chefs. (5) A rapid montage sequence shows close-up shots of multiple Chinese New Year dishes: a rich soup with abalone, sticky rice with sausage, a glazed braised pork leg, and a black chicken soup. Decorative text overlays appear at the top of each shot. (6) The chef stands in the center holding the product box. In the top corner, the bearded character gives a thumbs up. The video concludes with a full-screen promotional graphic showing the meal set and pricing.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a female voice calling 'Meimei' in a casual tone. A soft rhythmic percussion track starts in the background. A subtle thud sound occurs as objects are placed on wood. (2) A male voice with a deep, grumbling Taiwanese accent enters. A resonant gong sound effect marks a transition. The speaker uses a slow speech rate to express boredom. (3) A sharp electronic 'whoosh' sound effect triggers a change. The BGM tempo increases significantly. The male vocal shifts to a high-pitched, excited tone with frequent rising intonations. (4) A loud comedic 'pop' sound effect occurs as the chef begins speaking. The speech rate becomes very fast and energetic. Bright synth textures become more prominent in the mix. (5) A series of metallic 'ding' sound effects punctuate the listing of food items. The vocal intensity remains high. The BGM features a driving electronic beat that dominates the lower frequency range. (6) The final phase features a loud sales pitch with high vocal arousal. An impact SFX marks the final graphic. The music maintains a constant high-energy volume until a quick fade-out.
